clarifications: Alignment search may be algebraically factorized over independently rotated/reflected bands, then maximize over every band order. Full exhaustive adapter search remains oracle; equality is checked for each outer observed panel and a null panel. This changes no candidate freedom or score.

Wrong-unit means incompatible list cardinality in this adapter attempt; it must abstain, never truncate or wrap an incompatible list. This does not qualify same-length historical wrong-unit discrimination.

Exact E2 null tests use source-first transformations. A validated known cipher decoding cache and vectorized string equality may replace repeated pure decode calls; each outer panel and first/last null is replayed through the adapter.
H/F are dependent synthetic alternate readings of each panel; power/false flags reported separately and jointly, never treated as independent replications.
No primary B/C candidate or actual manuscript noise is selected; the 10%/20% masks are stress assumptions.
